Our logistics platform runs a fleet of AI agents that handle the full order lifecycle — from intake and inventory checks through fraud detection, payment, shipping, and customer notifications. Lately, the operations team has been complaining that orders are taking too long to process, and we suspect some agents are creating communication bottlenecks.

I've exported the raw inter-agent communication records for March 2026 into a file called `order_pipeline_comms_2026_03.json` located in the `ops/` folder. I need you to run a full analysis on this file and produce a complete structured report saved as `report.json`. This report should capture everything the analyzer can tell us about how our agents are communicating — traffic volumes, latency patterns, any bottlenecks, and whatever else is relevant.
